title: Automated Data Validation
prompt: Implement tests for schemas, duplicate keys, missing values, and invalid ranges.
scenario: Use the synthetic data described below to practise t, e, s, t, i, n, g,  , h, e, l, p, e, r, s,  , a, n, d,  , r, e, g, r, e, s, s, i, o, n,  , c, h, e, c, k, s. Do not assume the input is correct without validating it.

starter.code:
import pandas as pd

def validate(frame):
    assert {"id", "score"}.issubset(frame.columns)
    assert frame["id"].is_unique
    assert frame["score"].dropna().between(0, 100).all()

example = pd.DataFrame({"id": [1, 2], "score": [80, 90]})
validate(example)
print("valid")
starter.dataset_note: Use small synthetic in-memory data; do not place private or real customer data in exercises.
